title: DUST: Directional Uncertainty-aware and Scale-invariant Transfer Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.31948v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Transfer learning seeks to improve efficiency in a target regression task by borrowing information from related external source dataset(s). Existing approaches achieve this by enforcing Euclidean proximity between the target and source regression parameters or, more recently, by encouraging their directional alignment through angle-based penalties. While such angle-based penalties mitigate the sensitivity of the transfer learning methods to the scale differences between source and target regression coefficients, they still rely on a point estimate of the source regression parameter and thus provide no direct mechanism to incorporate uncertainty in the source information. translated_title: DUST：方向不确定性感知与尺度不变的迁移学习
translated_abstract: 迁移学习旨在通过借鉴相关外部源数据集的信息来提高目标回归任务的效率。现有方法通过强制目标回归参数与源回归参数之间的欧氏距离接近来实现迁移，或者最近通过基于角度的惩罚来鼓励二者的方向对齐。虽然这类基于角度的惩罚减轻了迁移学习方法对源和目标回归系数之间尺度差异的敏感性，但它们仍然依赖于源回归参数的点估计，因此没有提供直接机制来纳入源信息中的不确定性。为此，我们提出了一个用于迁移学习的概率框架，该框架在源回归参数估计的尺度不变方向分布层面进行操作，而非依赖其点估计，从而实现稳健的、尺度不变的且不确定性感知的迁移学习。
tldr: 提出了一种基于源回归参数尺度不变方向分布的概率迁移学习框架DUST，能够同时纳入源参数的不确定性并实现尺度不变且稳健的迁移学习。
en_tdlr: DUST is a probabilistic transfer learning framework operating on the scale-invariant directional distribution of source regression parameters, enabling robust, scale-invariant and uncertainty-aware transfer learning.
